description: This file defines the PurgeEntities class, which represents a command to purge (delete) specific entities of a certain type within a software system. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and comparison. It is part of a command framework for managing entities in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PurgeEntities
classes.description: Represents a command to purge specified entities of a certain type, including JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities and integration with command framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PurgeEntities instance with specified entity type, IDs, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic string for this command based on entity type.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type associated with the purge command.

methods.name: getEntityIds
methods.description: Returns the list of entity IDs to be purged.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.
